title: Parseval-Rayleigh identities for graded Artinian Gorenstein algebras
summary: We formulate and prove Parseval-Rayleigh identities for graded Artinian Gorenstein algebras over fields of positive characteristic. Specializing the general result, we provide an alternative proof of the Parseval-Rayleigh identities of generic Artinian reductions of Stanley-Reisner rings of oriented simplicial spheres.
